SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니, 우리 집에 계속 있을 생각이었어?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What, were you planning to stay at my place forever?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不然你打算一直待在家里吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不然你打算一直住在我們家嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: まさか、下宿にずっと住むつもりだったのか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Emang kamu rencananya mau tinggal di tempat aku selamanya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você achava que ia ficar na pensão pra sempre?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Pensabas quedarte en la pensión para siempre?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چی، قصد داشتی برای همیشه در خونه من بمانی؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니... 그래도 어떻게 붙잡을 생각을 안 해?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No… but shouldn’t you at least try to stop me?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不是...你怎么都不试着挽留我？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不是...就算這樣，你怎麼都不試著挽留我一下？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや…でも、止めようとは思わないの？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak sih… tapi kamu nggak mau coba cegah aku gitu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não… mas, você nem vai tentar me impedir?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No… pero, ¿ni siquiera vas a intentar detenerme?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه... اما نباید حداقل سعی کنی جلوی من را بگیری؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s gonna be just the two of us living together now —
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我们现在该两个人一起生活了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我們現在不是應該兩個人一起住嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: もう、俺たち二人で住む準備してるのに
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kita bakal tinggal berdua aja sekarang —
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Agora que vamos morar só nós dois,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ahora que vamos a vivir solo nosotros dos,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: حالا فقط ما دو نفر با هم زندگی می کنیم -

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 总不能一直住在那里吧
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 總不能一直住在這裡吧
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いつまでもそこにいられないだろ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: nggak mungkin kamu terus di sana selamanya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: não dá pra ficar lá pra sempre.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: no podemos quedarnos ahí para siempre.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما نمی توانید برای همیشه آنجا بمانید

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 말숙아 나랑 둘이 살자. 내가 잘해줄게.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Malsook, let’s live together. I’ll take good care of you.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 末淑啊，我们两个人一起生活吧，我会好好对你的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 末淑，我們就兩個人一起住吧，我會好好對待你的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: マルスク、一緒に暮らそう 俺がしっかりするから
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Malsook, tinggal bareng aku yuk. Aku bakal jagain kamu baik-baik.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Malsook, vamos morar juntos. Eu vou cuidar bem de você.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Malsook, vivamos juntos. Te voy a cuidar bien.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مال‌سوک، بیا با هم زندگی کنیم. من به خوبی از شما مراقبت خواهم کرد.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 너 그 말 무슨 뜻인지 알고 말하는 거야?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you even know what you’re saying?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你说这话的时候，知道自己什么意思吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你知道你自己在說什麼嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それ、どういう意味で言ってるか分かってるの？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu sadar nggak sih barusan ngomong apa?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você tem noção do que tá dizendo?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Come on, like I wouldn’t know.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 何だよ、分かってるくせに
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بیا، مثل اینکه من نمی دانم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman you said it first, okay?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 吴宥万，这话可是你先说的？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 吳宥萬，這話可是你自己先說的喔
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマン、今の言葉先に言ったからね？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yuman, kamu yang ngomong duluan ya, inget!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Yumán, foi você quem disse isso primeiro, hein?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Yumán, fuiste tú quien lo dijo primero, ¿eh?
